description: This file contains unit tests for the Consistent Ring Hash Provider and Virtual Buckets Ring Provider in the Orleans framework, including test classes, methods, and a fake silo status oracle implementation.

classes.name: ConsistentRingProviderTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the consistent ring hash provider and virtual buckets ring provider, testing server range distribution and queue assignment.

classes.name: FakeSiloStatusOracle
classes.description: A mock implementation of ISiloStatusOracle for testing purposes, simulating silo status management.

methods.name: ConsistentRingProvider_Test1
methods.description: Tests adding servers to a consistent ring provider and outputs the server ranges.

methods.name: ConsistentRingProvider_Test2
methods.description: Tests the virtual buckets ring provider with multiple silos and logs the distribution.

methods.name: ConsistentRingProvider_Test3
methods.description: Simulates a large number of silos, assigns queues, and analyzes the distribution across silos and agents.

methods.name: GetQueueHistogram
methods.description: Calculates the number of queues assigned to each silo range.
